retrievalProfile.description: A multi-layered montage illustration featuring a central blonde protagonist, a red sports car, and massive 3D extruded block lettering typical of 1970s thriller aesthetics.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dense, illustrative collage combining romantic and action-oriented vignettes with a dominant, perspective-distorted 3D title that looms over the central characters.
coreVisualRelationships: Massive 3D text acting as a physical canopy over the characters
Central blonde female figure as the primary focal point
Secondary vignettes showing a sports car, a house, and a couple in the foreground
Muted, grainy color palette with high-contrast red accents
coreInvariants: Deep black 3D extrusion on the main title text
Grainy, stippled texture across all illustrated surfaces
Red sports car in the bottom right foreground

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central blonde woman at medium scale, flanked by smaller character vignettes; title occupies the top 40% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the bold title down to the central woman, then circulating through the peripheral action scenes at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is packed with illustrative detail and texture.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep red for the title and sports car
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Forest green for foliage and black for shadows
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Desaturated mid-tones with high-value highlights and deep, flat black shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to red, green, black, and cream

letterConstructionRules: Extreme 3D extrusion pointing downward and toward a central vanishing point
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'U' and 'N' in the top line are compressed to fit the perspective arc
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A smaller, serif display font for secondary credits placed at the very top.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary heavy skeleton for the 3D effect.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a 70s pulp-style airbrushed montage featuring a blonde woman in a black dress, a red sports car in the foreground, and various small vignettes of houses and couples in a grainy, stippled style.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, red, extra-bold sans-serif text with a deep black 3D downward extrusion that follows a central perspective vanishing point.

verificationChecks: Is the 3D extrusion deep and black?
Does the illustration have a grainy, airbrushed texture?
Is the blonde woman the central figure?

mustRedesign: Contemporary sans-serif fonts like Inter or Roboto
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text extrusion does not obscure the central character's face.
Ensure the grain texture is consistent across the entire image.
Verify the red of the car matches the red of the title text.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Subject] with [Action Vignettes] under a [Color] [3D Extruded Title] in a [Grainy Airbrush] style.
